create_quantization_recipe: create an NVFP4 quantization recipe targeting Linear layers while skipping vision, audio, and lm_head modules
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a Gemma 4 multimodal model with NVFP4A16 scheme
build_quantized_model_pipeline: build a pipeline that loads a Gemma 4 model, quantizes it, and runs text generation
test_quantized_model_generation: test the quantized Gemma 4 model by generating text with a chat template prompt
save_quantized_model: save a quantized Gemma 4 model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format
